notes.title: Enter Into the Pit – FNaF: ITP Physical Editions Are Here! 🎮🐻
notes.content:
Hey, Gamer Cats!

We’re thrilled to announce that, in partnership with the paw-some team at iam8bit, Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit, based on the story written by Scott Cawthon and developed by yours truly at Mega Cat Studios, is getting a spooky physical release worldwide!

Here’s the scoop:

🎮 Two Editions to Choose From:

[olist]
[*] Retail Edition – Available for Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S with Smart Delivery for $29.99. Includes the game on cartridge or disc + a digital soundtrack code.

[*] iam8bit Exclusive Edition – For $34.99, you get the game + these killer extras:
[/olist]
[list]
[*] 🌟 A glow-in-the-dark fold-out poster to add that Freddy’s ambiance to your space

[*] 👾 Three sticker sheets for decorating your gear with some spine-chilling flair

[*] 🎧 A digital soundtrack to keep the scares going
[/list]
🐻 Pre-orders are LIVE and can be snagged at [url=intothepit.iam8bit.com]intothepit.iam8bit.com[/url]. The Exclusive Edition ships globally starting June 20, 2025.


🎥 Check out the Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=Y_-nuYc0w-M;full][/previewyoutube]

For more information about the game, visit our website at [url=megacatstudios.com]megacatstudios.com[/url]!

notes.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit is Now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit[/i] has officially been [b]Steam Deck Verified![/b] This means the game has been thoroughly tested and ensures a seamless, optimized experience on the Steam Deck.

[h3][b]What does this mean for you?[/b][/h3]
✅ Full functionality is accessible with the default controller configuration.
✅ Steam Deck controller icons are displayed correctly.
✅ All in-game text is easy to read on the Steam Deck’s screen.

Now, you can experience the terrifying thrills of Into the Pit anywhere you go. Get ready to take the horror with you anytime, anywhere. 🎮

If you haven’t tried it out yet, this is the perfect opportunity to experience the game on a whole new level of portability.

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear about your Steam Deck experiences!

notes.title: Hotfix Update v1.0.6.0
notes.content:
New quality of life improvements, fan requests, and bug fixes are LIVE to enhance your Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit experience.

[h3][b]Here's what's new:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New Languages:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Indonesian
[*] Traditional Chinese
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed getting stuck in the Under Oswald's Bed minigame
[*] Resolved Chica getting stuck by doors
[*] Fixed buttons appearing as white boxes
[*] Prevented Freddy from being visible during minigames
[*] Fixed the window escape QTE in Oswald's room
[*] Addressed getting stuck in the vent after calling Mom on Night 5
[*] Removed duplicate recording dots from the CCTV UI
[*] Fixed getting stuck when using the wrong item for the Party Room door
[*] Prevented getting stuck if Oswald is caught while using a door
[*] Enabled the Speedrun Timer from the Main Menu
[*] Corrected Steam achievement display issues
[*] Allowed interaction with Jinx after reloading a saved file
[/list]
[h3]We're also working on:[/h3]
[list]
[*] More languages on the way 
[*] Minigame tutorial improvements
[*] Additional bug fixes!
[/list]
[h3]Console Update:[/h3]
Console players! We are approved with all patches in all regions for console release and also have a final date approved by the Scottgames team to go live. As soon as we have approval to share the date, we will make an announcement! We are doing everything we can to give all console players the best version of the game possible on console launch day, including all fan requests, bug fixes, and quality-of-life updates. All consoles will also launch in all regions on the same day.

Your feedback is invaluable to us. We always strive to make Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit the best experience possible. If you have any questions or suggestions or encounter any other issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to our community forums, report via our [url=http://bit.ly/MCSITPBR][b]Bug Report Google Form[/b][/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/megacat][b]Discord[/b][/url] server.

Thank you for your continued support! 🐻

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3.0
notes.content:
Pepperoni pals! We've got one last hotfix rolling out for you before the weekend hits! Thank you all so much for your patience and love during this launch,  and we'll be continuing to roll out more improvements and fixes next week.

[b]This update is now live on our [u]public beta branch[/u].[/b] You can opt in by following the instructions in the video attached below. The fix will also be rolled out to the default branch once it’s confirmed to be stable.

[h3]Fixed Blockers:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed being unable to open pause menu to call mom
[/list]
[h3]Other improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare endless scroll on main menu
[*] Fixed some items missing in the Extras menu
[*] Fixed black screen when opening the inventory after jumping Into the Pit
    [i]Hotfix v1.0.1.0 fixed this issue when opening the map[/i]
[*] Fixed Extras Menu Inventory not showing highlights properly
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Chica's Scream[/spoiler] SFX missing after pausing the game for several seconds
[*] Fixed Sketchbook inventory description being incorrect
[*] Pause Menu now auto-scrolls when holding up/down buttons
[*] Going back from New Game to Main Menu now highlights the expected button
[*] Fixed some text not being affected by Dyslexic accessibility
[*] Fixed phone button staying highlighted after calling Mom
[*] Fixed some text overflowing in some languages and font settings
[*] Fixed dyslexic font reverting to default when returning to the title screen
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues: (We're working on them!)[/h3]
[i](Note: most of these are only happening to some users)[/i]
[list]
[*] Softlock when talking to Mike and Chip
[*] Performance issues when using controllers 
[*] Inputs not working on main menu
[*] Softlock when holding breath as the yellow rabbit appears
[*] Achievement notification sometimes remains for 15+ minutes
[*] White boxes instead of key prompts in some cases
[*] Game doesn’t resume after minimizing, with looping sound effects
[*] Missing phone keypad highlights
[*] Quest incorrectly asks to find Chip and Mike after they've already been found
[*] Battery UI not reappearing after playing arcade minigames
[*] Rare cases of crashes
[/list]
If you need further assistance, please reach us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2638370/discussions/][b]Steam Discussions[/b][/url], [url=https://s.team/chat/PZTOfWDl][b]Steam Live Chat[/b][/url], and/or [url=https://discord.gg/megacat][b]Discord[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit is now available!
notes.content:
[b][h1]The pit is calling. Are you ready to jump in?[/h1][/b]

The wait is over; [b]Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit[/b] is NOW LIVE!

On behalf of the Mega Cat team, we cannot thank the community enough for the  incredible support. We created this game as fans, for fans. From one FNaF to another, it’s a dream come true to see so many fans reciprocate the passion that we’ve poured into creating the game. 

Prepare to be terrified as you descend into the depths of the unknown and uncover the sinister secrets that lurk within. 

[h2]STAY CONNECTED[/h2]

Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/megacat]Discord[/url][/b] and stay up to date with patches, new features and content updates. Join the conversation, meet the team, and share your feedback, favorite pizza toppings and fan art.

If you encounter any issues while uncovering the pit's secrets, you may file a report using the [b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nc57Eu8uz8S_snZFklObSlNF2RENph-RI4pM8lYkIm8/edit#heading=h.io9k7otjbcim]in-game bug report tool[/url][/b]. Should the in-game bug report tool become unavailable, you may refer to this [b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdPpJDLzucEekKQd0F75-qqLxWJiPnSPTGwCChAYJbP_MX36Q/viewform]form[/url][/b], and our team will do our best to attend to your report as soon as possible. 

Stay updated with our other social accounts to get more news about FNaF: Into the Pit.
